verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask, but the probe found every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The evidence shows only an llms.txt index and markdown API reference pages (e.g., api-reference/v1/search.md), which are machine-readable docs, not an API spec. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only a few candidate paths, and a spec could exist at another location.
